title: Corporate Freight & Logistics Surcharge Policy
content: Standard dry-van, LTL, and liftgate freight surcharges are authorized up to 12% or $500.00 maximum over subtotal. Must be identified in document body or transport notes.

title: Vendor Settlement Discounts & Early Payment Terms
content: Approved vendor prompt payment terms (e.g. 2/10 Net 30) and volume promotional discounts are allowable deductions up to 15% of total. Reconcile as allowable credits.

title: TechParts Master Services Agreement Rider (Hardware Replacements)
content: TechParts International contract amendment Q1 2024: Component price fluctuations due to global DRAM/SSD shortages are permitted up to 3.0% tolerance against PO remaining balance.

title: Fuel Surcharge Emergency Allowance
content: Global Logistics Co carrier agreement allows supplementary diesel fuel surcharges calculated weekly, capped at 10% of total transport cost.
